location.story: How The Turtle Saved His Own Life

approved_translation: True friends do not believe lies told about those they know to be good.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: A king once had a lake made in the courtyard for the young princes to play in. They swam about in it, and sailed their boats and rafts on it. The Turtle laughed to himself as he slid away down the river to his old home. "Good!" he said, "those people do not know how safe I am in the water!"
